title: Elegant Scandinavian vase
author: Emde2828
description:
A modern Scandinavian-inspired vase featuring elegant vertical ribbing and a timeless minimalist silhouette. Designed for both fresh and dried flowers, it adds a refined Nordic touch to any home, office, or shelf. Perfect for 3D printing, with a sturdy closed base and clean, contemporary lines.
